subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat / async system events can interrupt and effectively swallow in-progress replies in Telegram topic sessions

question: Should the remaining fix make heartbeat/system-event work non-authorizing and isolated from active Telegram topic sessions by default, or preserve shared-session heartbeat behavior and split only narrower delivery bugs to existing trackers?
rationale: Current main fixed important subcases, but the remaining behavior requires a compatibility-sensitive policy choice about default heartbeat session sharing, Telegram-visible delivery boundaries, and route-aware recovery.

options.title: Keep as Telegram tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Telegram-topic tracker and require a maintainer-approved isolation or route-aware recovery design with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Split to canonical trackers
options.body: Move the remaining default-isolation work to the broad heartbeat tracker and delivery leakage to the text-leak tracker, then close this after preserving the Telegram evidence there.

options.title: Require fresh repro first
options.body: Do not change policy until a current-main live Telegram reproduction proves which remaining symptom still occurs after the partial fixes.

recommendation.title: Keep as Telegram tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Telegram-topic tracker and require a maintainer-approved isolation or route-aware recovery design with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and PR landing history put the recent heartbeat/reply-session behavior in this area under this handle, making it the best available routing owner for the policy call.
